name: Duty Shift
description: A reusable duty window (Morning, General, Night...). Depot admins pick one per roster day rather than typing times, so a shift-timing change is one edit here instead of hundreds across the roster.

fields.label: Shift Name
fields.description: What the engineer sees in the app, e.g. Morning.

fields.label: Ends Next Day
fields.description: Tick for a night shift, e.g. 22:00 to 06:00. Without this the shift is treated as zero-length and hours never add up.

fields.label: Late Grace (minutes)
fields.description: Arriving within this many minutes of start is not counted late.

fields.label: Early Check-in Window (minutes)
fields.description: How long before start the app offers the Check In button. Advisory — an early punch is still accepted and recorded.

fields.label: Colour
fields.options:
Blue
Green
Orange
Purple
Red
Grey
fields.description: Used on the roster grid and the app's duty card.

fields.label: Active
fields.description: Inactive shifts stay on existing rosters but stop being offered for new ones.
